mapper.select: SELECT A.BROD_ANNSEQ, A.BROD_CODE, A.ATCH_FILE_ID, A.ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN, A.ANNIVERSARY_TIME, A.ANNIVER_STARTDAY, A.ANNIVER_ENDDAY, A.ANNIVER_ORDER, A.ANNIVER_NAME, A.ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME, A.ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME AS anniversaryStartTime FROM TB_BRODANNIVERSARY A JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL B ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE C ON A.ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN = C.CODE WHERE A.BROD_ANNSEQ = #{brodAnnSeq}

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_BRODANNIVERSARY A JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL B ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE C ON A.ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN = C.CODE WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}
SELECT BROD_ANNSEQ FROM TB_BRODANNIVERSARY ORDER BY BROD_ANNSEQ DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO TB_BRODANNIVERSARY ( BROD_ANNSEQ, BROD_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN, ANNIVERSARY_TIME, ANNIVER_STARTDAY, ANNIVER_ENDDAY, ANNIVER_ORDER, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, ANNIVER_NAME, ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME ) VALUES ( #{brodAnnSeq}, #{brodCode}, #{atchFileId}, #{anniversaryGubun}, #{anniversaryTime}, #{anniverStartDay}, #{anniverEndDay}, #{anniverOrder}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{anniverName}, #{anniversaryStartTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO TB_BRODANNIVERSARY ( BROD_ANNSEQ, BROD_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN, ANNIVERSARY_TIME, ANNIVER_STARTDAY, ANNIVER_ENDDAY, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, ANNIVER_ORDER, ANNIVER_NAME, ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME ) SELECT NEXTVAL('conanniversary_seq'), #{brodCode}, ATCH_FILE_ID, ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN, ANNIVERSARY_TIME, #{anniverStartDay}, #{anniverEndDay}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ANNIVER_ORDER, ANNIVER_NAME, ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME FROM TB_BRODANNIVERSARY WHERE BROD_CODE = #{prebrodCode}

INSERT INTO TB_BRODANNIVERSARY ( BROD_ANNSEQ, BROD_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN, ANNIVERSARY_TIME, ANNIVER_STARTDAY, ANNIVER_ENDDAY, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, ANNIVER_ORDER, ANNIVER_NAME, ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME ) SELECT NEXTVAL('conanniversary_seq'), #{brodCode}, ATCH_FILE_ID, ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN, ANNIVERSARY_TIME, ANNIVER_STARTDAY, ANNIVER_ENDDAY, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ANNIVER_ORDER, ANNIVER_NAME, ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME FROM TB_BRODANNIVERSARY WHERE BROD_CODE = #{prebrodCode}

INSERT INTO TB_BRODANNIVERSARY ( BROD_ANNSEQ, BROD_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN, ANNIVERSARY_TIME, ANNIVER_STARTDAY, ANNIVER_ENDDAY, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, ANNIVER_ORDER, ANNIVER_NAME, ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME ) SELECT NEXTVAL('conanniversary_seq'), B.BROD_CODE, A.ATCH_FILE_ID, A.ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN, A.ANNIVERSARY_TIME, A.ANNIVER_STARTDAY, A.ANNIVER_ENDDAY, A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, A.ANNIVER_ORDER, A.ANNIVER_NAME, A.ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME FROM TB_BRODANNIVERSARY A JOIN TB_BRODSCHEDULE B ON B.BASIC_BROD_CODE = A.BROD_CODE AND B.BROD_CODE != A.BROD_CODE WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BRODANNIVERSARY SET BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}, ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId}, ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN = #{anniversaryGubun}, ANNIVERSARY_TIME = #{anniversaryTime}, ANNIVER_STARTDAY = #{anniverStartDay}, ANNIVER_ENDDAY = #{anniverEndDay}, ANNIVER_ORDER = #{anniverOrder}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = NOW(), ANNIVER_NAME = #{anniverName}, ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME = #{anniversaryStartTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE BROD_ANNSEQ = #{brodAnnSeq}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_BRODANNIVERSARY WHERE BROD_CODE IN ( SELECT BROD_CODE FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE WHERE BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} OR BASIC_BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} )
DELETE FROM TB_BRODANNIVERSARY WHERE BROD_CODE IN ( SELECT A.BROD_CODE FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A WHERE A.BASIC_BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} )
